scripts.build: npm run build -w @bulletin/web && npm run build -w @bulletin/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bulletin/web && npm run typecheck -w @bulletin/api
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:free: VITE_API_BASE_URL= VITE_MEDIA_BASE_URL= npm run build -w @bulletin/web && cd apps/api && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler deploy --config wrangler.free.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy:free: VITE_API_BASE_URL= VITE_MEDIA_BASE_URL= npm run build -w @bulletin/web && cd apps/api && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler deploy --config wrangler.free.jsonc
